notes.title: A monochrome love begins❤️《Life in The Janitor's Room with A JK Girl》is out now🔥
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/5bb3cfff3a0cea823e07d494e3318a2d9750b7a5.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3606830


“Hey, mister! I’m here again!”
The janitor’s dull routine changed the day her voice filled the room.
His once colorless life... might just be heading into spring.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/672256c1855488d93ca1c7c0356f93dcd45611a3.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/ae248b1d1d0614b3dc54f168cdb3d442415f5969.jpg[/img]

One day, gyaru schoolgirl Futaba Arisa barges into the janitor’s room
—and falls in love with the place.
Now she skips class just to hang out.
What should the older janitor do?

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/b2654c1c0b900f4074e338393cf2d905b52300ac.jpg[/img]

Simple: win her heart!
Talk, learn her story—and maybe pull a prank while she naps.
Raise her affection and unlock date events!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/19c0c9ae756ef6bfcc07230f34718debd8f5669e.jpg[/img]

With 50,000 words of emotional writing and a monochrome art style,
this game is for those who want to care for a lonely girl
—or fall in love with the beauty of a colorless world.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3606830
